name: Saltwatch Harbor Compact
description: Customs officials, reef pilots and harbor guards who protect the lawful port. Protect civilians and confront unauthorized wreckers.

name: Licensed Salvagers
description: Independent salvagers licensed to work the storm coast. Cooperate with Compact patrols but compete for salvage.

name: Unlicensed Wreckers
description: Unauthorized salvage bands willing to ambush crews and steal cargo. This is a working name for local hostile groups.

name: Independent Harbor Crews
description: Fisherfolk, repairers and independents who avoid violence unless threatened.
